items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: Oh, I didn't play with Tush Johnson too long, or maybe a year.

ctx.x: So, uh, how long did you stay with Tush Johnson?

Oh, I didn't play with Tush Johnson too long, or maybe a year. Those bands didn't work, uh, too regular. Uh-huh. I didn't, I didn't make any out-of-town jobs with them, because, uh, Papa wouldn't let me. You were too young. Yeah. Did they play what out of town?
